meta.amendment_scope: outcome taxonomy ONLY — no condition deleted or replaced, no fire-guard change, no controller change, falsifier and held-out seals untouched
meta.eligibility_property_test: same condition + same defender trajectory -> identical eligibility across arms; the predicate takes no arm argument
meta.results_not_in_hash: the protocol hash covers the taxonomy only; eligibility results below are an execution artifact, not part of the seal

version_record.note: no confirmatory result was produced under v0; the amendment is pre-execution, not a post-hoc reclassification

version_record.change: universal arm-blind no-fire classification; system-level and post-fire endpoints separated; gate failures made outcomes

post_fire.label: NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_POST_FIRE_CONTROLLER_EVALUATION
post_fire.rule: excluded from the post-fire denominator, but the count is stated on every table

system.label: NO_CAPTURE_ATTEMPT
system.rule: RETAINED in the system-level denominator; removing it would drop the hardest conditions and bias the campaign

no_fire_dual_endpoint.attribution: GUARD_CONTROLLER_INTERFACE_FAILURE — not a radial-controller failure, and not a system success

gmax_information_rule.objective: delta = argmax delta subject to full-gate and admissibility
gmax_information_rule.forbidden_objective: delta = argmax delta that survives falsification
gmax_information_rule.sequencing: delta and defender artifact sealed BEFORE that condition's falsifier runs

reporting.counting_rule: 'M of N' is permitted ONLY alongside the external-condition layer. 704 (condition, trajectory) pairs are NOT 704 independent samples

execution_order: 2  known counterexample 5x fresh-search rediscovery (falsifier regression; NOT external-generality evidence)
3  the 11 unresolved cells, fresh-seed confirmatory evaluation
4  arm-blind fire eligibility over the whole held-out set
6  RI-GMAX synthesised per condition, GATE-ONLY, then sealed
7  frozen falsifier v2 on eligible AND gate-valid artifacts
8  report IN_DISTRIBUTION and STRESS separately, in the condition hierarchy
